# SGEN: Dental Local SEO + AEO

> SGEN is a local search agency working with dental practices. We build map-pack and organic visibility in Google, and make practice websites quotable by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude. One monthly retainer, from $497, no setup fee, cancel any month.

Two separate jobs run under one invoice. The first is position: where a practice sits in Google's organic results and in the Google Maps three-pack for the treatments it wants to fill. The second is inclusion: whether an assistant names that practice at all when a patient asks which dentist nearby is worth booking. SGEN designs and ranks the practice website both jobs depend on. Single-chair practices through to multi-site groups. Billing is monthly through Stripe, with no setup fee and nothing to sign.

## Pages
- [Dental Local SEO + AEO](https://www.sgen.com/dental-local-seo-aeo): the dental landing page: how the work runs, what each tier costs, sample results and the full FAQ.

## Pricing
- Local SEO: $497/month
- Local AEO: $797/month
- SEO + AEO: $1,297/month
Stripe collects the retainer each month. Canceling takes two clicks in the customer portal: no setup fee, no onboarding charge, no exit fee, and everything already built stays on the practice's own domain.

## Method
Six stages: audit and entity mapping across 14 AI surfaces; foundation rebuild (Dentist schema, llms.txt, patient FAQ structures, Google Business Profile, Core Web Vitals); a content engine of 8–24 treatment pages a month; a citation network across local press and the dental directories that carry weight; weekly visibility reporting across Google and the four assistants; then scaling into further locations and treatment lines.

## Specialties served
Implants and full-arch cases, clear aligners and orthodontics, cosmetic work and whitening, gum disease and periodontal care, root canal work, dentures and crown-and-bridge, surgical extractions and oral surgery, children's dentistry, emergency and same-day appointments, and general and family practice.

## Key answers
- How fast does it work? Local rankings usually start moving between day 60 and day 120. Mentions inside ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity often arrive sooner, at 30 to 60 days, because answer engines re-crawl faster than Google does.
- Is there a way out? Yes. Stripe bills monthly and the practice cancels itself in the customer portal: no retention call, no exit fee. Every page, post, citation and link already built stays with the practice.
- What is AEO? Answer Engine Optimization. SEO argues for a position in Google's results and in Maps; AEO decides whether an AI assistant names the practice at all.
- Is there a contract? None. Month to month, nothing to set up and nothing to sign.

- Apply: https://www.sgen.com/dental-local-seo-aeo#get-started

## Pricing detail
- Local SEO: $497/month. Fifteen tracked keyword targets, four patient-facing articles a
  month, on-page work across 5+ pages a month, Google Business Profile optimization, 10 local
  citations and 3+ quality backlinks a month, schema markup, and a monthly performance report.
- Local AEO: $797/month. Ten prompts tracked across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and
  Claude, content shaped so assistants quote it, a cited patient Q&A library at 2+ posts a month,
  entity graph and knowledge-panel work, llms.txt and AI-agent permissions, conversational schema,
  an AI visibility dashboard covering all four assistants, and a monthly performance report.
- SEO + AEO: $1,297/month. Both engines together: 40+ keyword targets, 20
  tracked prompts, 12 articles plus 4+ cited Q&A posts a month, on-page work across 25+ pages a
  month, 40+ citations and 25+ links a month, and up to 6 programmatic location or treatment pages
  a month.
Every tier is billed monthly through Stripe and canceled in the customer portal. There is no setup
fee and no exit fee. The one item quoted separately is paid Google Ads management. Canceling leaves
every page, post, citation and link already built on the practice's own domain.

## Method detail
1. Audit and entity mapping (week 1): the Google footprint, how visible the practice already is
   inside the assistants, the citation profiles of the practices outranking it, and an entity graph
   built across 14 AI surfaces.
2. Foundation rebuild (week 2): Dentist schema, llms.txt, patient FAQ structures, a properly
   configured Google Business Profile, page speed and Core Web Vitals.
3. Content engine (ongoing): 8–24 pages a month answering what patients actually put to an
   assistant: what it costs, whether it hurts, how long it lasts, what happens at the first visit.
   Each page is structured to be quoted.
4. Citation network (ongoing): local press, the dental directories that carry weight
   (Healthgrades, Zocdoc, ADA Find-a-Dentist), plus Reddit, YouTube and the other sources language
   models are trained on.
5. Track and iterate (weekly): a visibility report every week covering Google, ChatGPT, Claude,
   Perplexity and Gemini. What is working gets more budget; what is not gets cut.
6. Scale (month 4 onward): once the core service area is held, it widens: further locations, new
   treatment lines, voice search and local video.

## Timeline
- Day 0: the practice picks a tier and checks out. The receipt lands before the tab is closed.
- Same day: a 90-second brief: the ZIP codes it draws from, the chairs that need filling, what
  the site runs on, and what a good quarter would look like. A senior strategist reads it before any
  call is offered.
- Within 24 hours: one named contact sends the baseline audit, the 30-day build order, and the list
  of AI prompts the practice will be tracked against.
- Within 7 days: work goes live: Google Business Profile cleaned up, schema installed, the first
  citations filed and the first pages published. The reporting clock starts.

## What is not offered
- No long-term contract, no setup fee, no onboarding charge, no exit fee. None of them exist here.
- No guaranteed ranking. Local search generally moves in 60-120 days and AI mentions in 30-60 days;
  three months is the honest minimum before judging the work.
